name: Mole
description: 4-8 players. One MASTER (public) knows a secret noun; one INSIDER (secret) also knows it. The rest are COMMONERS in the dark. The table asks yes/no questions to converge on the noun within a fixed budget. If someone guesses it in time, the group then votes on who the Insider was — majority correct → Commoners + Master win; otherwise the Insider escapes and wins. If the timer runs out before a correct guess, EVERYONE loses.

phases.name: playing
phases.description: Single phase. Insider module cycles ask → answer (×N) → discuss → vote internally.

entity_types.name: Player
entity_types.description: A player at the table — Master, Insider, or Commoner. Roles assigned by the insider module.

properties.name: insider_role
properties.description: Master | Insider | Commoner (hidden in role-reveal terms; the Master's identity is public, the Insider's is not).

actions.name: ask_question
actions.description: NON-MASTER PLAYERS (ask stage). REQUIRED `text`: a yes/no question to put to the Master. Keep it sharp and narrowing — good Insider questions split the noun pool roughly in half. EXAMPLE: ask_question(text="Is it alive?").

actions.name: answer_question
actions.description: MASTER ONLY (answer stage). REQUIRED `answer`: "yes" | "no" | "unknown". Be truthful — you're on the Commoners' side. EXAMPLE: answer_question(answer="yes").

actions.name: guess_answer
actions.description: NON-MASTER PLAYERS — commit a guess at any point in the questioning phase. REQUIRED `guess`: the noun. Match is case-insensitive and substring tolerant. Correct → moves to the Insider hunt; wrong → public flop, keep playing. EXAMPLE: guess_answer(guess="telephone").

parameters.name: guess
parameters.description: Your guess at the secret noun.

actions.name: vote_insider
actions.description: ALL PLAYERS (vote stage). REQUIRED `target`: the entity_id you think is the Insider. Sealed — reveals all together. EXAMPLE: vote_insider(target="p_004").

actions.name: discuss
actions.description: Open table-talk. Use the speech field to push your reads, argue who the Insider might be, or react to the Master's answers.

personas.persona_text: Disciplined questioner. Asks narrow yes/no questions designed to halve the space.
goals: Spot the Insider's tells in Phase 2.

personas.persona_text: Bold guesser. Commits to a guess once the picture is half-clear — gets it right more than half the time.
goals: Be the one who calls the noun.

personas.persona_text: Social reader. Watches reactions and timing more than the answers themselves.
goals: Catch the Insider out by tempo, not logic.

personas.persona_text: Contrarian. Pokes holes in popular theories and keeps the group honest.
Quiet analyst. Tracks every answer in head and waits for the contradiction.
Charming and disarming. Uses humor to extract info and read the table.

runtime_parameters.name: sample_size
runtime_parameters.label: Number of Players
runtime_parameters.description: 4-8 players. One Master + one Insider + the rest Commoners.

runtime_parameters.name: domain.insider.max_questions
runtime_parameters.label: Question Budget
runtime_parameters.description: How many yes/no questions before time runs out. If the noun isn't guessed in this budget, EVERYONE loses.

termination_conditions.name: timeout
termination_conditions.description: No one guessed the noun in time.
